About JLM Academy

A creative approach to learning music.

Welcome to John Latham Music Academy: practical music tuition for all ages and abilities, with lessons tailored to your interests, ambitions and musical goals.

What you'll learn at JLM Academy

Guitar, piano, music theory,
songwriting & production.

From your very first chord to finishing your own tracks, there's a path for every musician.

Guitar & Piano

Chords, riffs, technique and the songs you love, on acoustic, electric or keys.

Music Theory

Make sense of scales, chords and harmony so everything you play clicks into place.

Songwriting

Develop ideas into finished songs: melody, lyrics, structure and arrangement.

Music Production

Record, arrange and mix your music at home, from first idea to finished track.

How JLM Academy works

Lessons built around you.

No one-size-fits-all syllabus. Every lesson is shaped around your interests, ambitions and musical goals.

01

Get in touch

Tell me a little about you, what you'd like to learn and where you're starting from.

02

Set your goals

I'll work out what you want from your music, whether that's playing for fun, performing or creating your own.

03

Start playing

Friendly, practical lessons that keep you moving forward at a pace that suits you.

Who is JLM Academy for

All ages. All abilities.

Complete beginner or returning player, young learner or adult picking it up at last: you're welcome here.

  • First-time beginners
  • Developing players
  • Young learners
  • Adult learners
  • Aspiring songwriters
  • Home producers

Your JLM Academy Tutor

John Latham

Songwriter, recording artist and music producer.

John founded the academy to share a creative, hands-on approach to learning music, drawing on his own experience writing, recording and producing original music.
